extracted.intended_audience: photojournalism festival attendees, journalists, tourists, and the general public interested in photojournalism
extracted.subtask_description: Event listing / promotional page for the Visa pour l'Image international photojournalism festival in Perpignan, giving dates, schedules, venues, and information about awards and related publications. Aimed at visitors, exhibitors, and those interested in attending screenings, conferences and exhibitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibitions schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: “Exhibitions: every day from Saturday 30 august to Sunday 14 September , from 10am to 20pm”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Throughout the city, testimonies of journalists from worldwide are shown. Exhibitions are presented across the city and are open daily during the stated dates and hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Screenings schedule / format
rubrics_metrics.description: “Screenings: every day from Monday 1 to Saturday 6 September, at the Campo Santo (Every night for 6 days, 2 months of the past year are reviewed )”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open-air screenings take place in the Campo Santo cloister adjacent to the Cathedral of St John of Perpignan; the program reviews two months of the past year each night over six nights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meetings / Conferences schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: “Meetings / Conferences: every day from Monday 1 to Saturday 6 September at the convention center (Programme)”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Daily meetings and conferences are scheduled during the festival at the convention center; attendees should consult the programme for specific sessions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards categories
rubrics_metrics.description: “Several awards are given each year: the “Golden Visas” (categories News, Magazine, Daily Press) and the price of the city of Perpignan.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The festival confers prizes in specified categories (News, Magazine, Daily Press) and a city prize; the page also mentions a Camille Lepage prize endowment funded via book purchases as a way to honour photojournalistic courage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue — Campo Santo cloister
rubrics_metrics.description: “Open-air screenings in the beautiful Campo Santo cloister adjacent to the Cathedral of St John of Perpignan. Campo Santo in Perpignan”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Campo Santo is the principal screening venue; exhibitions occur throughout the city. Logistics note: regional train connections take visitors to Perpignan in under 20 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival mission / editorial focus
rubrics_metrics.description: “To demonstrate the reality of our troubled world and sometimes awake our sleeping consciences, these journalists have chosen photography.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The festival's curatorial aim is to present photojournalism that testifies to global realities and stimulates public conscience — a guiding principle for selection and presentation of work.
